what: 01456 (bump-allocate): deny blaze::hot_alloc crate by crate: base-db first, then hir-ty, then hir-def. For each crate root add: #![feature(register_tool)] #![register_tool(blaze)] #![deny(blaze::hot_alloc)] . Before denying, fix each finding (Vec::new_in(frame), from blaze_mem::frame::current) or end its line with // alloc: <why>. hot_alloc flags a call that reaches the global allocator through std or a registry crate, and a fresh global collection (Vec::new(), vec![], String::new(), FxHashMap::default(), Box::default()). A call of a workspace function is not a finding; its own body is. Candidate lines (a superset) are in /tmp/blaze-lanes/hot-alloc-sites.txt: base-db 13, hir-ty 225, hir-def 459. The workspace-wide warn round gives the exact list.
